questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/deleting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

(2, 9, 3),(5, 23, 4)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number × 3rd number) + 3 = 2nd number.

Now,

For, 2, 9, 3

⇒ (2 × 3) + 3 = 6 + 3 = 9.

For, 5, 23, 4

⇒ (5 × 4) + 3 = 20 + 3 = 23.

Similarly, for** (10, 33, 3)**

**⇒ (10 × 3) + 3 = 30 + 3 = 33.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements: **

All students are teachers.

No teacher is the Principal.

**Conclusions:**

I. No principal is student.

II. All teachers are students.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
Statements:

All students are teachers.

No teacher is the Principal.

The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1954cef2b04d66325d8e2febd33786f7c0056137482b76e2643690fc51f1a88.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No principal is student. - **True **(because All students are teachers, and No teacher is the Principal. So, No principal is student too)

II. All teachers are students. - **False **(because All students are teachers given. So, All teachers are students it can be possible but not definite)

Hence, the correct answer is "Only conclusion I follows".

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the fourth number is related to the third number.

45 ∶ 405 ∶ ∶ 20 ∶ 80 ∶ ∶ 85 ∶ ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **(1st number)² ÷**** 5 = 2nd number.**

Now,

For, 45 : 405

⇒ (45)² ÷ 5 = 2025 ÷ 5 = 405.

For, 20 : 80

⇒ (20)2 ÷ 5 = 400 ÷ 5 = 80.

Similarly, for **85 ∶ ?**

**⇒ (85)2 ÷ 5 = 7225 ÷ 5 = 1445.**

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 3"**.

questions.question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

M N _ _ Q M _ O _ Q _ N _ P Q M N O _ _
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: M N _ _ Q M _ O _ Q _ N _ P Q M N O _ _ 

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) PONPMOQP → M N __P__ __O__ Q / M __N__ O __P__ Q / __M__ N __O__ P Q / M N O __Q__ __P__

**Option 2) OPNPMOPQ **→ M N __**O**__ __**P**__ Q / M __**N**__ O __**P**__ Q / __**M**__ N __**O**__ P Q / M N O **__P__** **__Q__**

Here, 'M N O P Q' is the pattern.

Option 3) OPPNMOQP → M N __O__ __P__ Q / M __P__ O __N__ Q / __M__ N __O__ P Q / M N O __Q__ __P__

Option 4) PONPOMPQ→ M N __P__ __O__ Q / M __N__ O __P__ Q / __O__ N __M__ P Q / M N O __P__ __Q__

Hence, the correct answer is "**OPNPMOPQ**".

questions.question: Seven students, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are standing in a straight line facing north. D is standing to the immediate left of E but to the immediate right of C. B is standing to the immediate right of A and to the immediate left of C. Similarly, F is standing to the immediate left of G, who is standing at the extreme right end. Who is standing at the third position from the left end?
questions.solution:
Given: Seven students, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are standing in a straight line facing north.

1) B is standing to the immediate right of A and to the immediate left of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d83377627425c22939c6a6cabe8c6192bf8c8f7239c2006468af58f567251c99.png] 

2) D is standing to the immediate left of E but to the immediate right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/524535afbe3363c0f8bc8b3325d1f76e6160b043d31ad185eb49e959f8a73516.png] 

3) Similarly, F is standing to the immediate left of **__G, who__** is standing at the extreme right end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd56ad1adaf896239846aee8f91c46129d3b93a3ba9c272b5256b8407713d60c.png] 

So,** C** is standing at the third position from the left end.

Hence, the correct answer is** "C".**

questions.question:
If ‘A’ denotes ‘+’, ‘B’ denotes ‘×’, ‘C’ denotes ‘−’ and ‘D’ denotes ‘÷’, then what will come in place of ‘?’ in the following equation?

(8 B 4 A 3) D 7 = 33 D 11 A?
questions.solution:
Given Equation: (8 B 4 A 3) D 7 = 33 D 11 A ?

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Decoding the given information:

 
 

 Alphabet
 A
 B
 C
 D
 
 
 
 

 Meaning
 +
 ×
 −
 ÷
 
 

 

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ (__**8 × 4**__ + 3) ÷ 7 = __**33 ÷ 11**__ + ?

⇒ (__**32 + 3**__) ÷ 7 = 3 + ?

⇒ __**35 ÷ 7**__ = 3 + ?

⇒ 5 = 3 + ?

⇒ ? = __**5 - 3**__ = 2.

Hence, the correct option is "Option 2".
